title: 2025 AMC 12B Problem 25
statement: Three concentric circles have radii \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3.\) An equilateral triangle with side length \(s\) has one vertex on each circle. What is \(s^2?\)

solutions.text:
For the common center at distances \(1, 2, 3\) from the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side \(s,\) the identity \(3(1 + 16 + 81 + s^4)\) \(= (1 + 4 + 9 + s^2)^2\) holds. This simplifies to \(2s^4 - 28s^2 + 98 = 0,\) i.e. \((s^2 - 7)^2 = 0,\) so \(s^2 = 7.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: For a point at distances \(p, q, r\) from the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side \(a,\) there is a symmetric relation among \(p^2, q^2, r^2, a^2\)
